HardcoreRender.png|[[XR901]] on a render. }} ==Skin Trivia== *Parked outside of the Level 5 '''Mecha Base''' is the [[XR901]], part of the original XR series and not the Mark series. *The '''Mecha Base''' uses [[Medic]] upgrade icons instead of using its own unique ones. **Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], it used [[Military Base]]'s icons. *The '''Mecha Base''' uses the same humanoid as the [[Military Base]] and [[Ace Pilot]]. *The Level 4 '''Mecha Base''' does not have a proper tower and was just a blank concrete baseplate. **This might be because the '''Mecha Base''' is unfinished. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Mecha Base]]. Check the main article for statistical changes.'' *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]] **'''Mecha Base''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Default Level 0-4 appearance changed. **Initial unit changed from [[XR600]] to [[Mark I]]. **Level 2 unit changed from [[Armored XR600]] to [[Mark II]]. **Level 3 unit changed from [[XR700]] to [[Mark III]]. **Level 4 unit changed from [[XR900]] to [[Mark IV]]. **Level 5 unit changed from [[XR901]] to [[Mark V]]. *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **Updated explosion visual effects. *'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]] **Updated icon for the default skin. {{TowerNavBox}} {{ShadowTOC}} [[Category:Gallery]] [[Category:Exclusive Content]]
